values.note: C$35 a night plus tax for 15/30/50-amp sites; approved tent sites C$25; weekly C$210 plus tax and booking fee; C$3 booking fee.

fees.source: Edson Lions Park Campground's own site https://edsonlionsparkcampground.com/ ('Our Rates', 'Making a Reservation', amenities; read 2026-11-11): 'RV Park rates are as follows: $35.00 per night plus tax and $3.00 booking fee for 15 ,30 and 50 amp sites.', '$25.00 per night plus tax plus $3.00 booking fee for approved tent sites', 'Weekly Rate : $210.00 plus tax and booking fee'

values.note: The operator says 'mid April to Oct. 31'; the town's camping page says May to September.

season.source: Edson Lions Park Campground's own site https://edsonlionsparkcampground.com/ ('Our Rates', 'Making a Reservation', amenities; read 2026-11-11): 'Season: mid April to Oct. 31'; the Town of Edson camping page (Wayback 2025-11-01) 'Open: May to September'

booking.source: Edson Lions Park Campground's own site https://edsonlionsparkcampground.com/ ('Our Rates', 'Making a Reservation', amenities; read 2026-11-11): 'You can book online or call in (780)723-3169'; 'Book Now' links to the Premier Campground engine https://online.premiercampground.com/fbed54c7748a4ab692be8f2881613362 (site type 'RV - 30A')

hookups.source: Edson Lions Park Campground's own site https://edsonlionsparkcampground.com/ ('Our Rates', 'Making a Reservation', amenities; read 2026-11-11): 'We have 46 power sites 15/30/50amps(2), water fill stations and an on site sani-dump' (two 50-amp sites; water is at fill stations, not stated at the sites)

sites.source: Edson Lions Park Campground's own site https://edsonlionsparkcampground.com/ ('Our Rates', 'Making a Reservation', amenities; read 2026-11-11): 'We have 46 power sites' (plus 'approved tent sites'); the town page says '43 sites (27 with power, 16 non-powered)'

facilities.source: Edson Lions Park Campground's own site https://edsonlionsparkcampground.com/ ('Our Rates', 'Making a Reservation', amenities; read 2026-11-11): 'an on site sani-dump free for registered guests', 'clean washrooms and (FREE) showers , laundry and (FREE) WiFi for registered guests'

note: Edson Lions Club campground and hall just off the Yellowhead Highway (Hwy 16) on the east side of Edson; water fill stations, firewood for sale. --Claude
summary: Read the operator's own site and its Premier Campground engine: C$35 + tax + C$3 booking fee confirmed (tax now recorded as extra), weekly C$210; season derived May-Sep -> Apr 15 - Oct 31 ('mid April to Oct. 31'); sites 43 -> 46 power sites (operator); 50 amp (2 sites); dump, showers, laundry, wifi; reservable online. Phone confirmed. Not waterfront kept; pin on the campground.
flags: SEASON CONFLICT: operator 'Season: mid April to Oct. 31' vs Town of Edson page 'Open: May to September' (Wayback 2025-11-01). Wrote the operator's span with both in season.note.
SITES: operator '46 power sites 15/30/50amps(2)'; town page '43 sites (27 with power, 16 non-powered)'. Wrote 46 (operator).

OWNERSHIP (stored local, kept): the campground is run by the Edson Lions Club (Facebook link EdsonLionsClub; the hall is the Lions' hall). No source read states who owns the land; the town lists it among area campgrounds only. Not changed; the Lions-on-municipal-land rule would keep local if the land is the town's.

RATE DATE: the operator's rates page carries no year (footer 'Copyright (c) 2018'); the Premier engine sells nights but quoted none in November (closed season). Rate kept as the operator's current posted rate.
PHONE: stored 780-723-3169 matches the operator site and the town page. Confirmed.

WEBSITE: edsonlionsparkcampground.com answered 200 and is this campground. The second stored URL https://edson.ca/explore/camping redirects to www.edson.ca and answers a Cloudflare check (403) to curl and the headless browser; it is a town directory page listing several campgrounds (not this campground's own page).
GOOGLE: the lookup answered a list panel ('Results') showing 4.8 stars over 9 reviews at 53.58764,-116.41089 (the campground), not a single place panel; treat as unconfirmed.
PIN (53.5878,-116.4109): inside the campground (hall with the blue roof and the RV loops ~50-100 m SW/NE). No move.
WATERFRONT: not waterfront confirmed (no water beside the sites; a storm pond ~350 m SE across the highway ramp).
